title: render the influencer list table with pagination
acceptance: InfluencersPage renders a table of influencers fetched through the generated client, replacing the placeholder title
the table shows name, category, subtags, handles, country with city, gender and age columns
country codes render as locale-correct names through Intl.DisplayNames keyed on the active Lingui locale
the result count and page-of-N label come from the reply's pagination total
loading, empty and error states are rendered, and the error state offers a retry
all request and reply types derive from paths in @repo/api-client with no hand-written response types
new strings are extracted and translated across all seven locales so lingui compile --strict passes
the table scrolls within its own container at mobile widths without the page scrolling horizontally
verification_cmd: pnpm --filter web exec vitest run InfluencersPage
notes: Reuses the existing @repo/ui data-table and table-pagination exports; no new shared component. Filters arrive in phase 06.
review_findings:
BACKLOG_WORTHY:
- InfluencersTable.tsx:36 — `type HandleKey` restates three contract field names as a hand-written union instead of deriving from `Influencer`; harmless today but drifts silently if the reply's handle fields change (low priority).
- InfluencersTable.tsx:47-121 — TagList/InfluencerHandles/InfluencerLocation are single-use render helpers colocated in the composer; allowed by the 'small render helpers' exception, but if they grow they should move to components/ like InfluencerIdentity (low priority).
- apps/web/src/App.test.tsx:186 — out-of-scope edit, but justified and necessary: the routing test asserted the old placeholder heading and had to track the rename to 'Influencers'; already declared in the phase's out_of_scope_files (informational, no action).
